cards.name: Epic Struggle
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control twenty or more creatures, you win the game.

cards.name: Epic Confrontation
cards.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+2 until end of turn. It fights target creature you don't control. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)

cards.name: Radiant Epicure
cards.oracleText: Converge — When this creature enters, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of colors of mana spent to cast this spell.

cards.name: Epic Experiment
cards.oracleText: Exile the top X cards of your library. You may cast instant and sorcery spells with mana value X or less from among them without paying their mana costs. Then put all cards exiled this way that weren't cast into your graveyard.

cards.name: Voldaren Epicure
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to each opponent. Create a Blood token. (It's an artifact with "{1}, {T}, Discard a card, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

cards.name: Epicure of Blood
cards.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, each opponent loses 1 life.

cards.name: Epic Downfall
cards.oracleText: Exile target creature with mana value 3 or greater.

cards.name: Epic Proportions
cards.oracleText:

Enchanted creature gets +5/+5 and has trample.

cards.name: Epicenter
cards.oracleText:
